subject: Linear x-axis scaling using factor as variable (but keeping CI  constant)

messages.author: a1b789f07793ad75
messages.subject: Linear x-axis scaling using factor as variable (but keeping CI  constant)
parts:
Dear all,

My dataset consists of multiple groups with subjects scanned at 5
timepoints (7,21,49 and 70 days).

Values are fitted with a mixed linear model (repeated measures; nlme
package). I want to plot all values with the fitted lines + confidence
intervals.
I get nice plots using ggplot2, but do not know how to scale the x
axis. The point is that I have fitted 'time' as an ordered categorical
factor. This results in equal spacing of the x-axis. However, I want
to space the factors according to their days. (In other words, the x-
axis space between timepoint 3 days and 7 days should be less than
between 7 days and 21 days).

Adding: scale_x_continuous( breaks = seq(1,70,by=5)) gives an error
(due to the factor being plotted on the x-axis).

"Error: Non-continuous variable supplied to scale_x_continuous."

Plotting the converted factor (as.numeric(time)) gives proper linear x-
axis scaling, but results in fluctuating confidence intervals, which I
want to be straight.

These are example plots:

http://wistar.invivonmr.uu.nl/~wim/plot_ci_discrete_cc.png (nonlinear
x-scaling, but good CIs)
http://wistar.invivonmr.uu.nl/~wim/plot_ci_continues_cc.png (proper x-
scaling, but wrong CIs)

This is a snap from the code:

#
---------------------------------------------------------------------
# get CI from linear mixed model (nlme package)
#
---------------------------------------------------------------------
data$pred <- predict( model, data )
Designmat <- model.matrix( eval( model$call$fixed[ -2 ] ), data )
predvar <- diag( Designmat %*% model$varFix %*% t( Designmat ) )
data$SE <- sqrt( predvar )

#
---------------------------------------------------------------------
# plot individual values
#
---------------------------------------------------------------------

plot <- qplot( day, value, group = group, color = group, data = data )
+ geom_point( data = data )
plot <- plot + geom_smooth( aes( line = group, ymin = pred-2*SE, ymax
= pred+2*SE, stat="identity", group = group ) )

Thanks you for ideas to fix this!

Chris

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: RE: Linear x-axis scaling using factor as variable (but keeping CI 	constant)
parts:
Hi Chris,

What about combining geom_ribbon (http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_ribbon.html)
with geom_line instead of using geom_smooth for the ci?

Hope this helps,
fernando


library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(x = c(1, 5, 6, 1, 5, 6),
y = c(2, 3, 4, 1, .5, .1),
pred = c(2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 1.25, .75, .05),
se = c(.5, .25, .3, .2, .5, .1),
group = c("a", "a", "a", "b", "b", "b"))

ggplot(data = df, aes(x = x, y = pred, ymin = pred - se, ymax = pred + se,
group = group)) +
geom_ribbon(aes(fill = group), alpha = I(0.4)) +
geom_line(aes(colour = group)) +
geom_point(aes(y = y, colour = group))
